<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if (get_stylesheet() !== 'mojarrad') throw new RuntimeException('Theme activation failed');
if (!function_exists('mojarrad_register_content_types')) throw new RuntimeException('Plugin activation failed');
Mojarrad_Starter_Content::import_once();
if (wp_count_posts('moj_project')->publish < 8) throw new RuntimeException('Projects were not imported');
if (wp_count_posts('moj_news')->publish < 3) throw new RuntimeException('Editorial updates were not imported');
if (wp_count_posts('post')->publish < 8) throw new RuntimeException('Blog posts were not imported');
if (!get_page_by_path('about')) throw new RuntimeException('About page missing');
$draft = get_page_by_path('sakhtan-ya-sabr', OBJECT, 'post');
if (!$draft || $draft->post_status !== 'draft') throw new RuntimeException('Editorial draft missing or published');
